call_overview.title: About the call
call_overview.question: What does the call offer, and who can apply?

cards.title: What the call wants
cards.question: What is the principal thing the project must develop, and which problem or need must it address?
cards.answer:
Knowledge that lets offshore wind turbines last longer and lets their materials and components be reused at high value after decommissioning.
NWO (the Dutch Research Council) is still preparing this call under the Knowledge and Innovation Covenant (KIC, the Dutch agreement between government, research and industry on mission-driven research). The published description asks for knowledge on how materials degrade and fail, for design and material innovations that give longer service life and greater circularity, and for strategies to reuse, refurbish and recycle offshore wind turbines. Technological, economic, legal and organisational perspectives must be considered together, so that circular solutions can actually be implemented. The need is that of the offshore wind sector and of society's circularity goals; the call text that will say whose problem must justify a proposal has not yet been published.
cards.sources: NWO call page, KIC - Circularity of materials, components and structures in offshore wind · introduction and Disclaimer

cards.title: Project impact
cards.question: Which wider system outcomes and impacts must the project support?
cards.answer:
Longer-lived offshore wind turbines and high-value reuse of their materials, supporting circularity in offshore wind.
The call links service-life extension with reuse, refurbishment and recycling after decommissioning, which would lower material use and waste from the growing Dutch offshore wind fleet. Targets have not yet been published.
cards.sources: NWO call page, KIC - Circularity of materials, components and structures in offshore wind · introduction

cards.title: Who it suits

cards.title: Innovation
cards.question: How new must the project be, and in what must it innovate?
cards.answer:
The call asks for new knowledge and for design and material innovations, combined with implementation strategies.
It covers degradation and failure mechanisms (new knowledge), design and material innovations for longer life and circularity (technology), and reuse, refurbishment and recycling strategies seen from technological, economic, legal and organisational angles (a combination of technology, business and governance).
cards.sources: NWO call page, KIC - Circularity of materials, components and structures in offshore wind · introduction

call_overview.title: Relevance to TenneT
call_overview.question: Why is this call relevant to TenneT?

cards.title: Why it matters to TenneT
cards.question: Why does this call matter to TenneT, and why can't TenneT take part itself?
cards.answer:
Interpretation: TenneT connects offshore wind farms and maintains its own offshore structures, so knowledge on marine degradation and life extension is directly useful to it.
TenneT's offshore grid connections (Hollandse Kust, the 2 GW programme) depend on offshore wind farms that reach end of life, and TenneT protects its own offshore platforms against marine corrosion, as in its impressed current cathodic protection project. Research on degradation mechanisms, life extension and circular materials for offshore structures could inform the design and maintenance of platforms and foundations. The call's object is the turbines, which TenneT does not own, so the benefit is indirect, through knowledge and future hires. TenneT cannot be shown to have a role: the call is still in preparation and NWO has not yet published the rules on who may apply or take part.
cards.sources: Interpretation based on: NWO call page, KIC - Circularity of materials, components and structures in offshore wind · introduction and Disclaimer

funding_timing_submission.title: Funding
funding_timing_submission.question: How much funding can the project receive?

cards.title: Funding envelope
cards.answer:
NWO plans an indicative total budget of EUR 2.73 million for the call; the amount per project is not yet published.
- Grant request: not yet published; EUR 2,730,000 is the total for the call
NWO states that budget and dates of calls in preparation may still change and that the final call text decides.
cards.sources: NWO call page, KIC - Circularity of materials, components and structures in offshore wind · Characteristics, Budget; Disclaimer

funding_timing_submission.title: Timing
funding_timing_submission.question: What timing should the proposal submission and project follow?

cards.title: Application route
cards.answer:
One indicative deadline is known: full applications by 1 June 2027, 14:00, subject to change.
- Stage 1 — Full proposal: 1 June 2027, 14:00 (indicative)
NWO publishes the final call text, with the procedure, once its Executive Board approves the call.
